near_20.def: close within 3% below highest(close,20)[1], not a new high today

near_55.def: close within 3% below highest(close,55)[1], not a new high today

near_126.def: close within 3% below highest(close,126)[1], not a new high today

near_252.def: close within 3% below highest(close,252)[1], not a new high today

anynh_20.def: close > highest(close,20)[1] (any day, also inside a run)

anynh_55.def: close > highest(close,55)[1] (any day, also inside a run)

anynh_252.def: close > highest(close,252)[1] (any day, also inside a run)

runnh_20.def: close > highest(close,20)[1] and a new high also on one of the previous 10 bars

runnh_55.def: close > highest(close,55)[1] and a new high also on one of the previous 10 bars

runnh_252.def: close > highest(close,252)[1] and a new high also on one of the previous 10 bars

first_55_tight15_4.def: first_55 and previous 15 bars spanned < 4 ATR

first_55_tight25_4.def: first_55 and previous 25 bars spanned < 4 ATR

first_55_tightq15.def: first_55 and 15-bar range/price in its lowest quintile of 252 bars

first_252_tight15_4.def: first_252 and previous 15 bars spanned < 4 ATR

first_252_tight25_4.def: first_252 and previous 25 bars spanned < 4 ATR

first_252_tightq15.def: first_252 and 15-bar range/price in its lowest quintile of 252 bars

base15_4atr_uptrend.def: base15_4atr and close > sma(200) and close >= 0.85*highest(close,252)

vcpw20_first_20.def: range%(20) of three consecutive 20-bar windows before today strictly shrinking, then first_20

vcpw20_first_55.def: range%(20) of three consecutive 20-bar windows before today strictly shrinking, then first_55

vcpw10_first_20.def: range%(10) of three consecutive 10-bar windows before today strictly shrinking, then first_20

pivot_brk.def: first close above the last confirmed swing high (pivothigh 5/5)

vcp_piv_2c.def: pivot_brk and last two pullback depths shrinking (d1 > d0)

vcp_piv_3c.def: pivot_brk and last three pullback depths shrinking (d2 > d1 > d0)

vcp_piv_3c_near.def: vcp_piv_3c and close >= 0.85*highest(close,252) and close > sma(200)

vcp_piv_3c_tight.def: vcp_piv_3c and final pullback shallower than 8%

vcp_piv_expand.def: pivot_brk and pullback depths growing (d2 < d1 < d0), the opposite of a VCP

first_20_bbsq.def: first_20 and Bollinger width(20,2) made a 126-bar low within the previous 10 bars

first_55_bbsq.def: first_55 and Bollinger width(20,2) made a 126-bar low within the previous 10 bars

bbsq_bandbreak.def: close > upper Bollinger band (first in 10 bars) and width at a 126-bar low within the previous 10 bars

squeeze_only.def: Bollinger width(20,2) at a 126-bar low today (no breakout required)

first_20_near5.def: first_20 and close/highest(close,252) in band near5 (near5 >= 0.95, mid 0.80-0.95, deep < 0.80)

first_20_mid.def: first_20 and close/highest(close,252) in band mid (near5 >= 0.95, mid 0.80-0.95, deep < 0.80)

first_20_deep.def: first_20 and close/highest(close,252) in band deep (near5 >= 0.95, mid 0.80-0.95, deep < 0.80)

first_55_deep.def: first_55 and close/highest(close,252) in band deep (near5 >= 0.95, mid 0.80-0.95, deep < 0.80)

band_near5.def: close/highest(close,252) in band near5 (no breakout required)

band_mid.def: close/highest(close,252) in band mid (no breakout required)

band_deep.def: close/highest(close,252) in band deep (no breakout required)

don20_touch.def: high > highest(high,20)[1], first in 10 bars (intraday turtle trigger seen at the close)

don55_touch.def: high > highest(high,55)[1], first in 10 bars (intraday turtle trigger seen at the close)

don20_touch_fail.def: high > highest(high,20)[1] but close <= it (intraday breakout that did not hold)

ib_up.def: yesterday was ib; close > yesterday's high

ib_dn.def: yesterday was ib; close < yesterday's low

nr7_today.def: today's range is the narrowest of 7 (no breakout)

ath_first_252.def: close > highest close of ALL previous bars (>= 252 bars of history), first in 10 bars

ath_any_500.def: any all-time-high close with >= 500 bars of history

first_252_notath.def: first_252 that is NOT an all-time high (>= 500 bars of history)

fail_20_k3.def: first close below the first_20 breakout level within 3 bars of the breakout

held_20_k3.def: bar 3 after a first_20 breakout with no close below the level since

fail_20_k5.def: first close below the first_20 breakout level within 5 bars of the breakout

held_20_k5.def: bar 5 after a first_20 breakout with no close below the level since

fail_20_k10.def: first close below the first_20 breakout level within 10 bars

fail_20_late.def: first close below the first_20 breakout level 11-40 bars after the breakout

retest_20.def: within 10 bars of first_20: low <= level + 0.5 ATR, close > level, no close below the level since the breakout (first such bar)

low_first_20_up200.def: close < lowest(close,20)[1], first in 10 bars, close > sma(200)
